title: Easy Chicken Parmesan Recipe
reject_reason: Archetypal breaded baked chicken parmesan (marinara, mozzarella, parmesan) over spaghetti; same chicken-parmesan dinner identity as in-flight cheese-stuffed-chicken-parmesan and live chicken-parmesan-pasta, a saturated Italian-American lane that adds no novelty.
